description: This Java source file defines the InternalSelectionFocus activity, which demonstrates focus management behavior using custom InternalSelectionView widgets within an Android app. It constructs a horizontally oriented LinearLayout containing three InternalSelectionView instances, each configured with layout parameters and padding, to test focus rectangle reporting and focus change handling.

classes.name: InternalSelectionFocus
classes.description: An Activity that arranges three InternalSelectionView components in a horizontal layout to demonstrate focus management and rectangle reporting for transitions between views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates a horizontal LinearLayout, and adds three InternalSelectionView instances with specified layout parameters and padding.
